annotation.kind: faithful reconstruction of the complete SR_(p,r) recursive-summation probability bound in Theorem 4.3

assumptions: The exact sum is nonzero, so the relative forward error and kappa(a) are defined.
The output precision p and random-bit count r are positive.

The m rounded additions form the paper's left-to-right SR_(p,r) execution, with delta and beta linked to each actual pre-rounding value and satisfying the local error, history, conditional-mean, and zero-result requirements.
The errors alpha_k=delta_k-beta_k are mean independent and bounded by u_p, as proved in Lemma 3.10.
Each path-dependent coefficient remainder B_i satisfies the uniform equation (4.10) radius inherited from Lemma 3.10.
The centered suffix-product covariances satisfy the uniform gamma_m(u_p^2) consequence of reference [11, Lemma 3.1], which Theorem 4.3 explicitly invokes.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P17 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P17 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p17_t3_variance_plus_bias_probability_bound {m : Nat} {Omega : Type} [Fintype Omega] (run : P17VarianceRecursiveSumRun m Omega) (hsum : p17ExactSum run.a != 0) (lambda : Real) (hlambda_pos : 0 < lambda) (hlambda_lt_one : lambda < 1) : 1-lambda <= p17EventProb run.probability {omega | abs (p17RecursiveSum run.a (fun k => run.delta k omega) - p17ExactSum run.a) / abs (p17ExactSum run.a) <= p17SummationCondition run.a * (sqrt (p17Gamma m ((p17UnitRoundoff run.p)^2) / lambda) + p17Gamma m (p17UnitRoundoff run.p + p17UnitRoundoff (run.p+run.r)) - p17Gamma m (p17UnitRoundoff run.p))}
formal_statement.plain_language: With probability at least one minus lambda, the relative forward error of the computed SR_(p,r) recursive sum is bounded by kappa(a) times the exact variance radius plus the exact limited-precision remainder radius from Theorem 4.3.

informal_proof: Expand the generated recursive sum into its input suffix coefficients and split its exact error into M+A as in (4.8). Sum the source-derived suffix-product covariance bounds to prove E[M^2] <= (sum_i |a_i|)^2 gamma_m(u_p^2), then apply finite Chebyshev at radius (sum_i |a_i|) sqrt(gamma_m(u_p^2)/lambda). Sum Lemma 3.10's pathwise B_i bounds to obtain (4.10), combine both terms pointwise, and divide by the nonzero exact sum to obtain kappa(a) and equation (4.11).
informal_statement: Theorem 4.3 in full, with m=n-1: the SR_(p,r)-computed recursive sum satisfies the exact variance-based relative forward-error bound in equation (4.11) with probability at least 1-lambda.
paper_version: published journal version; SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 47(5), 2025, pages B1227-B1249
